# OmniOperand (omnioperand.com)
> High-precision quantitative computing engine, bidirectional geometric solvers, and exact radical mathematical derivations.

## Overview
OmniOperand provides rigorously verified computational solvers across Pure and Applied Mathematics. Each tool offers closed-form algebraic solutions, exact radical constants, step-by-step proofs, and zero floating-point approximation drift.

## Canonical Endpoints & Tools

### Polygons & Plane Geometry
- [Universal Regular Polygon Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/shapes/regular-polygon/): Master arbitrary n-sided regular polygon solver (3 to 1000 sides) with Archimedean circle convergence and exact radicals.
- [Regular Octagon Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/shapes/octagon/): 8-sided bidirectional solver for side, area, perimeter, apothem, circumradius, and 3 diagonal classes.
- [Regular Hexagon Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/shapes/hexagon/): 6-sided bidirectional solver with minimal/maximal diameters, circumradius R=a, and honeycomb metrics.
- [Regular Pentagon Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/shapes/pentagon/): 5-sided bidirectional solver with golden ratio (ϕ) diagonals, pentagram metrics, and radical area.
- [Regular Decagon Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/shapes/decagon/): 10-sided bidirectional solver with circumradius R=a·ϕ, flat-to-flat span, and 4 diagonal classes.
- [Right Triangle & Pythagorean Solver](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/right-triangle/): 12-variable right triangle solver for legs, hypotenuse, altitude, inradius, and acute angles.
- [Circle Sector & Segment Solver](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/circle-sector/): Circle curve solver for arc length, chord length, sagitta height, sector area, and segment area.
- [Roof Pitch & Rafter Length Solver](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/roof-pitch/): Carpentry roof slope solver for pitch-in-12, degrees, rafter length, plumb cuts, and birdsmouth cuts.

### Three-Dimensional & Civil Engineering
- [Concrete Volume & Bag Count Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/3d/concrete-volume/): Cubic yards, cubic feet, cubic meters, and 60lb/80lb premix bags for slabs, footings, and cylindrical columns.
- [3D Geometry & Spatial Hub](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/3d/): Spatial polyhedra, prisms, cylinders, and structural volume.

### Calculus & Mathematical Analysis
- [Definite & Indefinite Integral Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/calculus/integrals/): Evaluates exact closed-form antiderivatives, definite integrals, and Simpson's/Trapezoidal Riemann sums.
- [Derivative & Tangent Line Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/calculus/derivatives/): Computes polynomial derivatives, instantaneous slope, tangent lines, normal lines, and concavity.

### Quantitative Finance & Debt
- [Mortgage Amortization & Early Payoff Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/finance/mortgage-amortization/): Fixed-rate mortgage payment matrix, borrowing capacity inversion, and accelerated payoff savings.
- [Compound Interest & Investment Growth Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/finance/compound-interest/): Discrete and continuous compounding, periodic deposits, APY conversions, and savings goal inversions.
- [Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/finance/cagr/): Geometric mean growth rate, portfolio doubling periods via Rule of 72, and target valuation inversions.
- [Auto Loan & Car Affordability Calculator](https://omnioperand.com/finance/auto-loan/): Car loan installment payments, trade-in sales tax credits, dealer fees, and affordability inversion.

### Hub Directories
- [2D Shapes & Polygons Hub](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/shapes/): Taxonomy of regular and equilateral polygon formulas.
- [Two-Dimensional (2D) Geometry](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/2d/): Planar geometry, triangles, quadrilaterals, circles, and conic sections.
- [Geometry Master Hub](https://omnioperand.com/geometry/): Euclidean, analytic, coordinate, and 3D spatial geometry.
- [Calculus & Analysis Hub](https://omnioperand.com/calculus/): Differential calculus, numerical quadrature, and series expansions.
- [Quantitative Finance Hub](https://omnioperand.com/finance/): Debt amortization, compound interest, CAGR, and consumer lending.
- [Physics & Mechanics Hub](https://omnioperand.com/physics/): Kinematics, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics.
- [Probability & Statistics Hub](https://omnioperand.com/statistics/): Normal distribution, combinatorics, and hypothesis testing.

## Programmatic REST API & Machine Endpoints

- [OpenAPI 3.1.0 Specification](https://omnioperand.com/api/v1/openapi.json): Full machine-readable schema for ChatGPT Custom Actions, Claude MCP, and autonomous AI agents.
- [REST API Explorer & Documentation](https://omnioperand.com/api/): Interactive edge tester and developer documentation.
- [Universal Regular Polygon API](https://omnioperand.com/api/v1/geometry/2d/shapes/regular-polygon): GET/POST endpoint for n=3 to 1000.
- [Regular Octagon API](https://omnioperand.com/api/v1/geometry/2d/shapes/octagon): GET/POST endpoint for 8-variable closed-form radical calculations.

## Mathematical Quick Reference

### Finance & Mortgages
- Fixed-Rate Mortgage: M = P · [i(1 + i)ⁿ] / [(1 + i)ⁿ - 1]
- Borrowing Power Inversion: P = M · [(1 + i)ⁿ - 1] / [i(1 + i)ⁿ]
- Compound Interest: FV = P(1 + r/m)ᵐᵗ + PMT · [((1 + i_p)ᴺ - 1) / i_p]
- APY: APY = (1 + r/m)ᵐ - 1 (Continuous: APY = eʳ - 1)
- CAGR: CAGR = (V_n / V_0)^(1/n) - 1
- Doubling Period: t = ln(2) / ln(1 + CAGR) ≈ 72 / CAGR_pct

### Construction & Spatial Geometry
- Concrete Slab Volume: V (yd³) = [Length_ft × Width_ft × Depth_in / 12] / 27
- Concrete Bag Equivalencies: 45 bags of 80-lb concrete ≡ 1 cubic yard (0.60 ft³/bag)
- Roof Pitch: Angle θ = arctan(Rise / 12)
- Common Rafter Multiplier: M = √(1 + (Rise/12)²)

### Plane Geometry
- Right Triangle: a² + b² = c² | Altitude h_c = (a · b) / c | Inradius r_i = (a + b - c) / 2
- Circle Sector: Arc s = R · θ_rad | Chord c = 2R · sin(θ_rad / 2) | Sagitta h = R · (1 - cos(θ_rad / 2))
- Sagitta-Chord Inversion: R = (c² / 8h) + (h / 2)
- Sector Area: A_sec = ½ R² θ_rad | Segment Area: A_seg = ½ R² (θ_rad - sin θ_rad)

### Calculus
- FTC Part 2: ∫_a^b f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a)
- Simpson's 1/3 Rule: (Δx / 3) [f(x₀) + 4f(x₁) + 2f(x₂) + … + f(xₙ)]
- Tangent Line: y - y₀ = f'(x₀)(x - x₀)
- Normal Line: y - y₀ = (-1 / f'(x₀))(x - x₀)
